programme.title: SOKO Kitzbuhel / SOKO Kitzbuhel
programme.desc: The Tyrolean Unterland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offers is the scene of the police team around criminal officer Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, which specializes in criminal psychology, who, with a lot of expertise and empathy, put the craft from the local criminals. The investigators are understood by Karin's father Hannes, who runs the legendary inn "Pochlarner Stuben", and is blessed with a similar criminalistic sense of gaze. And finally there is Grafin Schonberg, who, with her contacts to the Kitzbuheler JetSet, proves again and again as valuable help for the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - UEFA conference league / Fudbal - UEFA Konferencijska liga
programme.desc: From 2021. Years of football lovers enjoy the League Conference organized by UEFA. The idea for her appeared in 2015. years, and includes lower ranked teams of state championships. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams that are divided into eight groups per four are entered into the competition. 16 teams progresses in the eighth final, then quarterfinals, semifinals and finals. / Od 2021. godine ljubitelji fudbala uživaju Ligi Konferencija koju organizuje UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane timove državnih prvenstava. Kvalifikacije su podijeljene u dva dijela, nakon kojih u takmičenje ulaze 32 tima koji su podijeljeni u osam grupa po četiri. 16 timova napreduje u osminu finala, zatim četvrtfinale, polufinale i finale.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football - Poland League / Fudbal - Poljska liga
programme.desc: Ekstraklasa is the highest professional football league of Poland. The first league of Poland in football was founded in 1927. years, and the League organizes the Football Association of Poland (PZPN). Currently, 16 teams participate in the league, and the winner directly wins the title of the Polish Champion. / Ekstraklasa je najviša profesionalna fudbalska liga Poljske. Prva liga Poljske u fudbalu osnovana je 1927. godine, a tu ligu organizuje Fudbalski savez Poljske (PZPN). Trenutno u ligi sudjeluje 16 ekipa, a pobjednik direktno osvaja titulu poljskog šampiona.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the proposal of the French journalist Gabriela Hanot in 1955. The Champion Cup was established, a yearly continental competition in which only the champions of their states perform. The media popularization of this format in 1992. The UEFA Champions League, competition for all the best clubs of Europe was established. The placement in the Champions League Clubs achieve a result in the league competitions of his state. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Черно пространство / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Директорът познава Давиди от дете и е изненадан, че е станал полицай, защото винаги са смятали, че ще бъде от другата страна. Шефката му Русо му изпраща за партньор детектив Мораг, която се занимава с подобни случаи. Давиди се чуди как ще работи с нея. Зохар, който постоянно се моли, е нападнат и му е оставен библейски надпис "око за око". Отказва да подаде жалба, защото се страхува. Чино от киберсистеми следи камерите, коаито вече са на всякъде. Училището е отворено и има охрана и полицейско присъствие. Някои родители отказват да пуснат децата си. Бащата на убития Дор се обръща към родителите, които се възмущават, че децата им са заподозрени. Въпреки зверството, Риф се възхищава на идеята за еднорозите. Взема пистолета на баща си и го показва на Маян, която му е бясна. Родителите започват да разговарят с децата си и да ги следят. Том е тартор на една от групите. Прави списък на съученици и не пуска никой извън него в дома си. / Директорът познава Давиди от дете и е изненадан, че е станал полицай, защото винаги са смятали, че ще бъде от другата страна. programme.title: Черно пространство / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Появява се видео, в което човек с маска на еднорог се обръща заплашително към всички: "Мислите, че кошмарът е свършил? Събудете се , виждаме всичко. Няма да спрем, докато не накажем виновниците, ще ви намерим." Учениците са втрещени и уплашени. За следователите е ясно, всичко е саморазправа. Бащата на Дор отива да намери в училището раницата му. Детектив Давиди не го пуска, но е учуден, че е изчезнала и иска описание. Давиди открива мястото, където е заснето видеото и завежда там Мораг. Разказва й за времето, когато е учил в същото училище и за инцидента, в който е пострадало окото му. Бащата на Итамар подозира сина си за стрелбата. Маян казва на Давиди, че гаджето й Риф е направил видеото, а също и за пистолета. Казва, че с Шаул са при "самотното дърво". Арестуват ги. Разпитите са дълги и тежки. Когато разбират, Томи и Шир правят парти при дървото. Итамар харесва Либи и тя го знае. Гай я предупреждава да не си играе с него. / Появява се видео, в което човек с маска на еднорог се обръща заплашително към всички: "Мислите, че кошмарът е свършил? Събудете се , виждаме всичко. programme.title: Черно пространство / Черно пространство
programme.desc: Появява се видео, в което човек с маска на еднорог се обръща заплашително към всички: "Мислите, че кошмарът е свършил? Събудете се , виждаме всичко. Няма да спрем, докато не накажем виновниците, ще ви намерим." Учениците са втрещени и уплашени. За следователите е ясно, всичко е саморазправа. Бащата на Дор отива да намери в училището раницата му. Детектив Давиди не го пуска, но е учуден, че е изчезнала и иска описание. Давиди открива мястото, където е заснето видеото и завежда там Мораг. Разказва й за времето, когато е учил в същото училище и за инцидента, в който е пострадало окото му. Бащата на Итамар подозира сина си за стрелбата. Когато разбират, Томи и Шир правят парти при дървото. Итамар харесва Либи и тя го знае. Гай я предупреждава да не си играе с него. / Появява се видео, в което човек с маска на еднорог се обръща заплашително към всички: "Мислите, че кошмарът е свършил? Събудете се , виждаме всичко. programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Wehen - Bayern, Football, German Cup / Wehen - Bayern, Nogomet, Njemački kup
programme.desc: DFB-Pokal-(Sport. Program, Germany) The very beginning of the German Cup or DFB Cups dates back to 1935 when it was launched under the name Tschammer-Pocal. 64 teams participate in this competition, including all clubs from the first and second Bundesliga, with the first four teams on the third league rankings. The rest of the participants come from the winner of the regional buyers. The matches are played for a single Cup system in which extensions are played after a regular 90 minutes and after the penalty box if the winner does not decide by then. The finals have been played every year starting in 1985 at the Olympic Stadium in Berlin. The Cup winner provides a placement in the UEFA Europa League ... / DFB-Pokal - (sport. program, Njemačka) Sami početak Njemačkog kupa ili DFB pokala datira još od 1935. godine kada je pokrenut pod nazivom Tschammer-Pokal. U ovome natjecanju sudjeluje 64 momčadi uključujući svi klubovi iz prve i druge Bundeslige uz prve četri momčadi na ljestvici treće lige. Ostatak sudionika dolazi od strane pobjednika regionalnih kupova. Utakmice se igraju po jednostrukome kup sistemu u kojemu se nakon regularnih 90 minuta igraju produžetci i nakon toka jedanaesterci ukoliko se do tada ne odluči pobjednik. Finale se igra svake godine počevši od 1985. godine na Olimpijskom stadionu u Berlinu. Pobjednik kupa osigurava plasman u UEFA Europa Ligi...

programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Athletic Bilbao - Man United, Nogomet, Europa liga / Athletic Bilbao - Man United, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. The qualifications are divided into two parts, after which 32 teams that were divided into eight groups per four are in the competition. 16 Teams progresses in the eighth final, then quarterfinals, semifinals and finals ... / UEFA Conference League - (sport. program) Od 2021. godine ljubitelji nogometa uživaju u Ligi Konferencija koju organizira UEFA. Ideja za nju pojavila se 2015. godine, a uključuje niže rangirane momčadi državnih prvenstava. programme.title: Salzburg - Dinamo, Football, Champions League / Salzburg - Dinamo, Nogomet, Liga prvaka
programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a champion Cup was established, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Finals, Football, Europa League / Finale, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.title: Diplomat, Nine for IX / Diplomat, Nine for IX
programme.desc: NINE FOR IX - (Sport. Program, USA) Documentary series on the occasion of the 40th anniversary of the adoption of the Law aimed at discrimination in educational institutions financed by the USA in the United States. The law had a huge impact on the world of a female sport, which is still noticeable inequality among gender-related gender, media coverage and the leading position in clubs. The series brings us stories athletes that (from) boriled for a better position in this world of men, like Pat Summit, Katarina Witt and Venus Williams ... / Nine for IX - (sport. program, SAD) Dokumentarna serija povodom 40. godišnjice donošenja zakona usmjerenog protiv diskriminacije u obrazovnim institucijama koje se financiraju od strane saveznih vlasti u SAD. Zakon je imao ogroman utjecaj na svijet ženskog sporta u kojem je i danas primjetna nejednakost među spolovima vezano uz zaradu, medijsku pokrivenost te vodeće pozicije u klubovima. Serija nam donosi priče sportašica koje su se (iz)borile za bolji položaj u ovom svijetu muškaraca, poput Pat Summit, Katarine Witt i Venus Williams...

Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. programme.title: Rijeka - PAOK, qualifications for the Europa League 2025/2026. / Rijeka - PAOK, Kvalifikacije za Europsku ligu 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.title: Rudeš - Orient, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 3rd round / Rudeš - Orijent, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 3. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

It was this interesting football year, so you can be sure that you are waiting for fun minutes! ... / Vikend vatrenih - (sport. program, Hrvatska) Budite uz našu emisiju i pogledajte najistaknutije poteze naših reprezentativaca u međunarodnim ligama. Bila je ova zanimljiva nogometna godina, pa možete biti sigurni da vas čekaju zabavne minute! ...

programme.title: Zebec / Zebec
programme.desc: Zebec - (Sport. Program) Documentary film about one of the most successful Croatian football players, Branko Zebec, who left an indelible mark on the history of football ... / Zebec - (sport. program) Dokumentarni film o jednom od najuspješnijih hrvatskih nogometaša, Branku Zebecu koji je ostavio neizbrisiv trag u povijesti nogometa...

programme.title: PAOK - Rijeka, qualifications for the Europa League 2025/2026. / PAOK - Rijeka, Kvalifikacije za Europsku ligu 2025./2026.
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (Sport. Program, 2025) Europa League has a special charm given that this is the most massive competition under the auspices of Uefe. A large number of clubs are included in the qualifying process and the first meetings start at the end of June. This competition is specific because because of its abundance, it also gives "smaller" clubs to feel what it is like to play matches on the European scene. Given that the concentration of strong European clubs is primarily in the Champions League and the local championships in the Europa League, there are big surprises that prove that everyone knows how to play quality football today. Don't miss in these summer months of duel teams you can't follow every day! ... / Football: UEFA Europa League Qualifiers - (sport. program, 2025) Europa liga ima posebnu draž s obzirom da je to najmasovnije natjecanje pod okriljem UEFE. Velik broj klubova je uključen u proces kvalifikacija te prvi susreti počinju već krajem lipnja. Ovo natjecanje je specifično jer zbog svoje brojnosti daje mogućnost i "manjim" klubovima da osjete kako je to igrati utakmice na europskoj sceni. S obzirom da je koncentracija jakih europskih klubova primarno na Ligi prvaka i domaćim prvenstvima u Europa ligi dolazi do velikih iznenađenja koja dokazuju da danas svatko zna igrati kvalitetan nogomet. Nemojte propustiti u ovim ljetnim mjesecima dvoboje momčadi koje ne možete pratiti svaki dan!...

programme.title: Super heating - SuperSport HNL / Super zagrijavanje - SuperSport HNL
programme.desc: Super heating - (Sport. Program, Croatia, 2025) Announcement of the 5th round of the SuperSport HNL ... / Super zagrijavanje - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Najava 5. kola SuperSport HNL-a...

programme.title: Rudeš - Orient, SuperSport First Football League 2025/2026, 3rd round / Rudeš - Orijent, SuperSport Prva nogometna liga 2025./2026., 3. kolo
programme.desc: Football - First Croatian League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The first football league is the Croatian Football Competition of the second rank, which was founded in 1991 after the breakup of Yugoslavia. Next year, the first season was played in which the clubs were divided into four regions, and a higher ranking was progressed from each region. With numerous changes to the competition system, this league is known for developing many young players who later affirmed themselves in strong first -team players such as Dinamo, Hajduk and Rijeka ... / Football - First Croatian League - (sport. program, 2025) Prva nogometna liga je hrvatsko nogometno natjecanje drugog ranga koje je osnovano je 1991. godine nakon raspada Jugoslavije. Sljedeće godine je odigrana i prva sezona u kojoj su klubovi bili podijeljeni u četiri regije te je iz svake regije jedan klub napredovao viši rang. Uz brojne izmjene sustava natjecanja, ova liga je poznata po razvoju mnogo mladih igrača koji su se kasnije afirmirali u jakim prvoligašima kao što su Dinamo, Hajduk i Rijeka...

programme.title: Valentino Rossi - the story of a man and a driver / Valentino Rossi - Priča o čovjeku i vozaču
programme.desc: The Valentino Rossi Story - (Doc. Film, France, 2025) we bring a documentary about the Italian Motorcycle Champion Valentin Rossi. Rossi is a multiple champion, who started his career in 1996, and besides winning, he is also known for his brave acrobatics ... / The Valentino Rossi Story - (dok. film, Francuska, 2025) Donosimo dokumentarni film o talijanskom prvaku u motociklizmu Valentinu Rossi. Rossi je višestruki prvak, koji je svoju karijeru započeo 1996. godine, a osim po pobjedama, poznat je i po svojim hrabrim akrobacijama...

programme.title: Istria 1961 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025/2026, 5th round / Istra 1961 - Gorica, SuperSport HNL 2025./2026., 5. kolo
programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: Barefoot through Australia / BarfuSS durch Australien
programme.desc: Svenja (Anneke Kim Sarnau) and her 16-year-old daughter Kira (Amira Demirkiran) have come around the world a lot. Svenja is a hotel manager, at the moment she is getting an aging hotel in Australia back in shape. But her greatest challenge is her daughter, who has switched to complete refusal and does not let Svenja say anything more. Even at school, Kira does not avoid a confrontation, which in turn leads to conflicts with Svenja. After a new argument, Kira dropped off to Jack (Tjirrdm McGuire). Jack is Aboriginal and Kira's only friend. Together, the two young people search for their "Special Place", their own special place. Svenja is worried about herself when she noticed Kira's disappearance and takes the persecution with Jack's father Kalti (Aaron Pedersen), a deep -relaxed boat guide that Svenja had released two days earlier. An adventurous journey into the barren, deserted outback - for Svenja and Kira, begins a strange world, fascinating, but also life -threatening. / Svenja (Anneke Kim Sarnau) und ihre 16-jahrige Tochter Kira (Amira Demirkiran) sind viel in der Welt herumgekommen. Svenja ist Hotelmanagerin, momentan bringt sie ein in die Jahre gekommenes Hotel in Australien wieder auf Vordermann. Doch ihre groSSte Herausforderung ist ihre Tochter, die auf Komplettverweigerung geschaltet hat und sich von Svenja gar nichts mehr sagen lasst. Auch in der Schule geht Kira keiner Konfrontation aus dem Weg, was wiederum zu Konflikten mit Svenja fuhrt. Nach einem neuerlichen Streit haut Kira kurzentschlossen ab zu Jack (Tjirrdm McGuire). Jack ist Aboriginal und Kiras einziger Freund. Gemeinsam machen sich die beiden Jugendlichen auf die Suche nach ihrem "Special Place", ihrem eigenen besonderen Ort. Svenja ist auSSer sich vor Sorge, als sie Kiras Verschwinden bemerkt, und nimmt mit Jacks Vater Kalti (Aaron Pedersen), einem tiefenentspannten Bootsguide des Hotels, den Svenja zwei Tage zuvor entlassen hatte, die Verfolgung auf. Es beginnt eine abenteuerliche Reise in das karge, menschenleere Outback - fur Svenja und Kira eine fremde Welt, faszinierend, aber auch lebensgefahrlich.

programme.title: Die Kublbock-Story - Eure Lana Kaiser / Die Kublbock-Story - Eure Lana Kaiser
programme.desc: The 2000s marked the beginning of a new TV era with "Deutschland sucht den Superstar" and at the same time the beginning of Lana Kaiser's career, then known as Daniel Kublbock. The documentary series shows the then often difficult zeitgeist for non-heterosexual people and accompanies a life in the spotlight with all the high and depths of a medial instant career. The teenager from Lower Bavaria broke disturbed rules and was loved for it - but also hated. How do you manage to get up again and again as a young person? To understand this, Lana's difficult childhood is illuminated and other prompt experiences that have become their drive. / Die 2000er Jahre markierten mit "Deutschland sucht den Superstar" den Beginn einer neuen TV-Ära und zeitgleich den Beginn der Karriere von Lana Kaiser, damals bekannt als Daniel Kublbock. Die Doku-Serie zeigt den damals fur nicht-heterosexuelle Menschen haufig schwierigen Zeitgeist und begleitet ein Leben im Rampenlicht mit allen Hohen und Tiefen einer medialen Instant-Karriere. Der Teenager aus Niederbayern brach unerschrocken Regeln und wurde dafur geliebt - aber auch gehasst. Wie schafft man es, als so junger Mensch dennoch immer wieder aufzustehen? Um das zu verstehen, wird Lanas schwierige Kindheit beleuchtet und weitere pragende Erfahrungen, die zu ihrem Antrieb wurden.

programme.title: At the end of summer / Am Ende des Sommers
programme.desc: Ben (18) passed the school with flying colors and Sylvia (34) has every reason to be proud of him. On her son and on herself. After all, she raised Ben all by itself and today he is an all -round successful boy. Ben only knows about his conception that he is a child of pure love. He likes the romantic story about the interrail acquaintance, a love for only one day, and that's why it is so big. Ben never knew his father, so he didn't miss him either. Sylvia is a mother and closest confidante at the same time. But this trust threatens to break when Sylvia is obtained from her past and Ben has to find out that he is actually a product of rape. In one fell swoop, everything seems to be questioned, the relationship between mother and son, the past, not least of the self -understanding. Because as much as Sylvia insists on being the mistress of her past and history alone, Ben has to find his own. / Ben (18) hat die Schule mit Bravour bestanden und Sylvia (34) hat allen Grund, stolz auf ihn zu sein. Auf ihren Sohn und auf sich selbst. SchlieSSlich hat sie Ben ganz allein groSSgezogen und heute ist er ein rundum gelungener Junge. Über seine Zeugung weiSS Ben nur, dass er ein Kind der reinen Liebe ist. Er mag die romantische Geschichte uber die Interrail-Bekanntschaft, eine Liebe fur nur einen Tag, und gerade darum so groSS. Ben hat seinen Vater nie gekannt, deshalb fehlt er ihm auch nicht. Sylvia ist ihm Mutter und engste Vertraute zugleich. Doch dieses Vertrauen droht zu zerbrechen, als Sylvia von ihrer Vergangenheit eingeholt wird und Ben erfahren muss, dass er in Wahrheit Produkt einer Vergewaltigung ist. Mit einem Schlag scheint alles in Frage gestellt, das Verhaltnis zwischen Mutter und Sohn, die Vergangenheit, fur Ben nicht zuletzt das Selbstverstandnis. Denn so sehr Sylvia darauf pocht, allein Herrin ihrer Vergangenheit und Geschichte zu sein, Ben muss seine eigene finden.

programme.title: 40 years of live AID / 40 Jahre Live Aid
programme.desc: On July 13, 1985, the legendary benefit concert took place live AID - a music event that has campaigned for an end to famine in Africa with a lot of commitment, honest sympathy and creativity. The four -part documentation draws the impressive history of this international auxiliary movement based on archive material and current interviews - above all with main initiator Bob Geldof. Together with his colleague Midge Ure, he wrote the benefit song Do They Know Its Christmas? And convinces pop -large such as Duran Duran, Bono, George Michael and Phil Collins, to record the track free of charge and to give all income to the starving in Ethiopia. The impressive positive response to these efforts soon leads to a similar initiative in the United States. The band AID Trust is founded to also use long -term support for Africa. / Am 13. Juli 1985 fand das legendare Benefiz-Konzert Live Aid statt - ein Musikevent, das sich mit viel Engagement, ehrlicher Anteilnahme und Kreativitat fur ein Ende der Hungersnot in Afrika eingesetzt hat. Die vierteilige Dokumentation zeichnet anhand von Archivmaterial und aktuellen Interviews - allen voran mit Hauptinitiator Bob Geldof - die beeindruckende Geschichte dieser internationalen Hilfsbewegung nach.Aufgeruttelt durch eine alarmierende TV-Reportage beschlieSSt der irische Musiker Bob Geldof im spaten Oktober 1984, selbst aktiv zu werden. Zusammen mit seinem Kollegen Midge Ure verfasst er den Benefiz-Song Do They Know its Christmas? und uberzeugt PopgroSSen wie Duran Duran, Bono, George Michael und Phil Collins, den Track unentgeltlich aufzunehmen und alle Einnahmen an die Hungernden in Äthiopien zu ubergeben. Die uberwaltigend positive Resonanz auf diese Bemuhungen fuhrt alsbald zu einer ahnlichen Initiative in den Vereinigten Staaten. Der Band Aid Trust wird gegrundet, um auch langfristige Unterstutzung fur Afrika zu gewahrleisten.

programme.title: The Viennese Alps - on the way with friends / Die Wiener Alpen - Unterwegs mit Freunden
programme.desc: The area extends over the hunched world, the changing country, the Semmering-Rax-Schneeberg region and the snow gland. In a round trip, the film presents people who are committed to sustainability, a reflection on the essentials: sustainable land management, high -quality foods from regional generation and a conscious handling of one of the cheapest cultural landscapes in Central Europe. 21 years ago, Lukas Heilingetzer fell a lifelong dream and bought an old farmhouse in the hunched world. He keeps old, sometimes almost disappeared fruit varieties for posterity and proudly raises that he owns around 450 apple varieties. In Lichtenegg, the two young farmers Antonia Krenn and Michael Mandl process the milk of their 100 goats into a tostal organic and organic yoghurt. A Muhle, which was created in Gutenstein in 1576, now serves as a forest farmer museum, and if you want to stop after their visit, the Steinfeldhof from Michael and Gerald Jeitler lines with regional delicacies. / Das Gebiet erstreckt sich uber die Bucklige Welt, das Wechselland, die Semmering-Rax-Schneeberg-Region und das Schneebergland. In einer Rundreise stellt der Film Menschen vor, die sich der Nachhaltigkeit, einer Besinnung zum Wesentlichen, verschrieben haben: Nachhaltige Landbewirtschaftung, hochwertige Lebensmittel aus regionaler Erzeugung und ein bewusster Umgang mit einer der schonsten Kulturlandschaften Mitteleuropas.Vor 21 Jahren hat sich Lukas Heilingsetzer einen Lebenstraum erfullt und ein altes Bauernhaus in der Buckligen Welt gekauft. Er bewahrt hier alte, teils fast schon verschwundene Obstsorten fur die Nachwelt auf und erzahlt stolz, dass er etwa 450 Apfelsorten sein Eigen nennt. In Lichtenegg verarbeiten die beiden Jungbauern Antonia Krenn und Michael Mandl die Milch ihrer 100 Ziegen zu kostlichem Biokase und Biojoghurt. programme.title: At the scene / Am Schauplatz
programme.desc: It is one of the oldest businesses in Austria, the showman. Anyone who works as a showman is on the move for months, from one place to another. The season lasts around 120 days. Around 20 voks festival places are approached each year and up to 100,000 kilometers with huge saddle tractors and caravans are laid out. It is quite a special job: body -strictly exhausting, weather dependent - a fixed workplace with fixed working hours is definitely not. At the scene of reporter Gudrun Kampelmuller, people accompany people who earn their money with the driving spare industry who travel to small and large Volksfest-Platz to give joy to other people with a carousel and autodrome. / Es ist eines der altesten Gewerbe Österreichs, die Schaustellerei. Pro Jahr werden etwa 20 Voksfestplatze angefahren und bis zu 100.000 Kilometer mit riesigen Sattelschleppern und Wohnwagen zuruckgelegt. Es ist ganz ein spezieller Beruf: korperlich anstrengend, wetterabhangig - ein fixer Arbeitsplatz mit fixen Arbeitszeiten ist es auf jedenfall nicht. Am Schauplatz Reporterin Gudrun Kampelmuller begleitet Menschen, die mit dem Fahrgeschaft-Gewerbe ihr Geld verdienen, die auf kleine und groSSe Volksfest-Platze reisen, um anderen Menschen mit Karussell und Autodrom Freude zu bereiten.

programme.title: Eco special / Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: Philosophical forum / Philosophisches Forum
programme.sub-title: Liebe, Leidenschaft und Ehe - Wie geht Beziehung heute?
programme.desc: The longing for close, security and a shared life of life exists. Even people over 70 still hope for great love. The freedom of our time also brings great challenges for pleasure and love questions: How do self-optimization and dating apps invent our attachment- and our picture of love? What is love at all? And does it also need the institution of marriage? -BARBARA Stockl and Konrad Paul Liessmann in the "Philosophical Forum" with*) Emilia Roig (political scientist),*) Robert Pfaller (philosopher),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (doctor and psychotherapist),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Broll (philosophical practitioner),*) Martin Lintner (moral theologist). / Die Sehnsucht nach Nahe, Geborgenheit und einem gemeinsamen Lebensentwurf besteht alters- und generationenubergreifend. Selbst Menschen uber 70 hoffen noch auf die groSSe Liebe. Die Freiheit unserer Zeit bringt zugleich groSSe Herausforderungen fur Lust- und Liebesfragen: Wie verandern Selbstoptimierung und Dating-Apps unsere Bindungsfahigkeit - und unser Bild von Liebe? Was ist Liebe uberhaupt? Und braucht es dazu noch die Institution der Ehe? - Daruber reden Barbara Stockl und Konrad Paul Liessmann im "Philosophischen Forum" mit*) Emilia Roig (Politologin),*) Robert Pfaller (Philosoph),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (Ärztin und Psychotherapeutin),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Brull (Philosophische Praktikerin),*) Martin Lintner (Moraltheologe).

programme.title: Today my husband is getting married / Heute heiratet mein Mann
programme.desc: Caroline and Robert are happily and satisfied. Robert's upcoming wedding throws more off the track than she thought. And in Robert, who deals with his failed relationship with Caroline due to the event, the doubt also germinates: was the divorce perhaps too hasty after all? And why is he jealous of this man, who has recently been bustling on Caroline's side? And while Roberts organizes the celebrations, Caroline and Robert drift more and more towards each other. programme.title: Eco special / Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: Eco special / Eco Spezial
programme.sub-title: Putins Flotte - russische Spionage in der Ostsee
programme.desc: The fate of Ukraine is being negotiated between the United States, Europe and Russia. The West hopes for peace with sufficient security guarantees for Ukraine. Nevertheless, Russia is not only provoking with massive night drone attacks on Kiev, but also with a war drone that has been lined up by Uber Polish territory. For more than a year, Russia has been testing NATO in the Baltic Sea with ships. Healthy Europe has been vulnerable. Here are the modern lifeline: pipelines, power lines and data cables. If they are destroyed, millions of households could no longer be cared for, and the explosion of the North Stream pipelines three years ago was considered a warning shot. At that time, politicians from all over Europe emphasized the need to better use critical infrastructure. The offshore wind farms, the performance of which should grow enormously in the coming decades, are part of this vital infrastructure. In the nearby pipelines and cables, ships are repeatedly seen under Russian flag that have switched off their location systems and want to remain undetected. You are interested in everything that lies on the sea floor. A whole armada old tanker makes the Baltic Sea unsafe. It is not just about Russian oil, but also about espionage and hybrid war altitude. In the North and Baltic Sea, more than 60 particularly suspicious activities of critical infrastructure could be identified, such as very slow sneak trips and zigzag courses. What is the secret mission of the ships? Why do you drive without position data and have armed special forces on board? And why is it so difficult for the police and militar to act against the mysterious ships? Eco-special from the NDR. Report: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann and Benedikt Strunz. / Das Schicksal der Ukraine wird gerade zwischen den USA, Europa und Russland verhandelt. Der Westen hofft auf einen Frieden mit ausreichenden Sicherheitsgarantien fur die Ukraine. Dennoch provoziert Russland nicht nur mit massiven nachtlichen Drohnenangriffen auf Kiew, sondern unter anderem mit einer Kriegsdrohne, die uber polnischem Staatsgebiet abgesturzt ist. Schon seit mehr als einem Jahr wird von Russland in der Ostsee die Abwehr der NATO mit Schiffen getestet.Verborgen am Meeresgrund ist Europa verwundbar. Hier liegen die modernen Lebensadern: Pipelines, Stromleitungen und Datenkabel. Werden sie zerstort, konnten Millionen Haushalte nicht mehr versorgt werden.Die Explosion der Nord-Stream-Pipelines vor drei Jahren galt vielen als Warnschuss. Politiker aus ganz Europa betonten damals die Notwendigkeit, kritische Infrastruktur musse besser geschutzt werden. Auch die Offshore-Windparks, deren Leistung in den kommenden Jahrzehnten enorm wachsen soll, sind Teil dieser lebenswichtigen Infrastruktur.In der Nahe von Pipelines und Kabeln werden immer wieder Schiffe unter russischer Flagge gesehen, die ihre Ortungssysteme abgeschaltet haben und unentdeckt bleiben wollen. Sie interessieren sich fur all das, was am Meeresboden liegt. Eine ganze Armada alter Tanker macht also die Ostsee unsicher. Es geht dabei nicht nur um russisches Öl, sondern auch um Spionage und hybride Kriegsfuhrung.Der Norddeutsche Rundfunk (NDR) zahlte bei einer Recherche dutzende Durchfahrten. In Nord- und Ostsee konnten auSSerdem mehr als 60 besonders verdachtige Aktivitaten uber kritischer Infrastruktur identifiziert werden, wie etwa ganz langsame Schleichfahrten und Zickzackkurse.Was ist die geheime Mission der Schiffe? Warum fahren sie haufig ohne Positionsdaten und haben bewaffnete Spezialkrafte an Bord? Und wieso fallt es Polizei und Militar so schwer, gegen die mysteriosen Schiffe vorzugehen?ECO-Spezial vom NDR.Bericht: Marie Blocher, Antonius Kempmann und Benedikt Strunz.

programme.title: Philosophical forum / Philosophisches Forum
programme.sub-title: Liebe, Leidenschaft und Ehe - Wie geht Beziehung heute?
programme.desc: The longing for close, security and a shared life of life exists. Even people over 70 still hope for great love. The freedom of our time also brings great challenges for pleasure and love questions: How do self-optimization and dating apps invent our attachment- and our picture of love? What is love at all? And does it also need the institution of marriage? -BARBARA Stockl and Konrad Paul Liessmann in the "Philosophical Forum" with*) Emilia Roig (political scientist),*) Robert Pfaller (philosopher),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (doctor and psychotherapist),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Broll (philosophical practitioner),*) Martin Lintner (moral theologist). / Die Sehnsucht nach Nahe, Geborgenheit und einem gemeinsamen Lebensentwurf besteht alters- und generationenubergreifend. Selbst Menschen uber 70 hoffen noch auf die groSSe Liebe. Die Freiheit unserer Zeit bringt zugleich groSSe Herausforderungen fur Lust- und Liebesfragen: Wie verandern Selbstoptimierung und Dating-Apps unsere Bindungsfahigkeit - und unser Bild von Liebe? Was ist Liebe uberhaupt? Und braucht es dazu noch die Institution der Ehe? - Daruber reden Barbara Stockl und Konrad Paul Liessmann im "Philosophischen Forum" mit*) Emilia Roig (Politologin),*) Robert Pfaller (Philosoph),*) Martina Leibovici-Muhlberger (Ärztin und Psychotherapeutin),*) Cornelia Mooslechner-Brull (Philosophische Praktikerin),*) Martin Lintner (Moraltheologe).

programme.title: Today my husband is getting married / Heute heiratet mein Mann
programme.desc: Caroline and Robert are happily and satisfied. Robert's upcoming wedding throws more off the track than she thought. And in Robert, who deals with his failed relationship with Caroline due to the event, the doubt also germinates: was the divorce perhaps too hasty after all? And why is he jealous of this man, who has recently been bustling on Caroline's side? And while Roberts organizes the celebrations, Caroline and Robert drift more and more towards each other. But: has the upgrading old feel really mean something .....? / Caroline und Robert sind glucklich und zufrieden geschieden. Roberts bevorstehende Hochzeit wirft Caroline aber dann doch mehr aus der Bahn, als sie gedacht hatte. Und in Robert, der sich aufgrund des Ereignisses wieder mit seiner gescheiterten Beziehung zu Caroline auseinander setzt, keimt auch der Zweifel: War die Scheidung vielleicht doch zu voreilig? Und wieso ist er eifersuchtig auf diesen Mann, der sich neuerdings an Carolines Seite tummelt? Und wahrend Roberts Zukunftige die Feierlichkeiten organisiert, driften Caroline und Robert immer mehr aufeinander zu. Aber: Hat das Aufwallen alter Gefuhle wirklich etwas zu bedeuten.....?

Das klingt erst einmal abschreckend. Doch wie steht es wirklich um die Gesellschaft in dem islamischen Konigreich? Wie leben die Menschen hier, wovon traumen sie, was erhoffen sie sich von der Zukunft? In Dschidda, Saudi-Arabiens buntester Stadt am Roten Meer, traumt die 18-jahrige Dschumana Chalid davon, eines Tages als erste saudische Primaballerina offentlich zu tanzen. Huda Talbani pfeift auf die strengen Regeln und hat sich mit ihrem mobilen Haustier-Service selbststandig gemacht. Die Manner dagegen, so hat es den Anschein, halten an ihren Traditionen fest. Die unmittelbare Nahe Dschiddas zu Mekka lasst Ali mindestens einmal im Jahr zur heiligsten Statte des Islams pilgern. Dort findet er Ruhe und die Bestatigung, auf dem richtigen Weg zu sein. Und in den Bergen der Provinz Asir suchen einige Manner sogar Zuflucht in den Traditionen ihrer Vorvater.

programme.title: Land of the mountains / Land der Berge
programme.desc: Hutten can also be monuments. Although they are mostly simple and functional, they still commit landscape and culture. The spectrum is large and ranges from the alpine pasture and hunting huts to the high alpine mountains. Even on the high alpine mountain huts, times have changed: what was more recently a saving protective hut, for example, has often become a safe destination to be achieved today. The expectations of the guest have also changed. Today, some hikers are more like a chic Alpine hotel than a Spartan mattress camp. Sybille Krafft and her team came into the Esterreich and Bavarian mountains and talked to Huttenwasters, alpine farmers, alpine farmers about the history of their building. Whether in the Allgau, in the Ötztal or in Jachenau - the monument -friendly use of a historical hat is a special challenge for everyone. (2018) / Auch Hutten konnen Denkmaler sein. Obwohl sie meist einfach und zweckmaSSig sind, pragen sie dennoch Landschaft und Kultur. Das Spektrum ist groSS und reicht von der Alm- und Jagdhutte bis zur hochalpinen Berghutte. Selbst auf der hochalpinen Berghutte haben sich die Zeiten geandert: Was fruher beispielsweise eine rettende Schutzhutte war, ist heute oft ein gefahrlos zu erreichendes Ausflugsziel geworden. Dabei haben sich auch die Erwartungen der Gaste gewandelt. Heute wunscht mancher Wandersmann eher ein schickes Alpenhotel als ein spartanisches Matratzenlager. Sybille Krafft ist mit ihrem Team in die osterreichische und bayerische Bergwelt vorgedrungen und hat sich mit Huttenwirten, Almbauern und Sennerinnen uber die Geschichte ihrer Gebaude unterhalten. Ob im Allgau, im Ötztal oder in der Jachenau - die denkmalgerechte Nutzung einer historischen Hutte ist fur alle eine besondere Herausforderung. (2018)

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: At the end of the summer episodes, Harry drove to Sudburgenland. Jennersdorf is located in the center between the Flussen Raab and Lafnitz, in the three-country corner of Hungary and Slovenia. After a look at the Jostmuhle, in which grain is still ground and which also serves as a foam, Harry takes the first break in the rustic village host house "Hirtenfeld". Freshly stamped, it goes to animal observation in the "natural corner of the leaf". The Prinz family has started care for injured or abandoned animals here, and a species protection project has also developed from this. After a short stop in a big hat, the Therme Loipersdorf, is stopped in the Uhudlerviertel on Hochberg. The area is the home of the once tasted Uhudler. In the "Hoch-Zeitschenke" in Eltendorf, the host couple Matthias and Carina have actually married and now offer this possibility of other couples. / Zum Abschluss der Sommer-Folgen fahrt Harry ins Sudburgenland. Jennersdorf liegt im Zentrum zwischen den Flussen Raab und Lafnitz, im Drei-Lander-Eck zu Ungarn und Slowenien. Nach einem Blick in die Jostmuhle, in der noch Getreide gemahlen wird und die auch als Schaumuhle dient, macht Harry erste Rast im urigen Dorfwirtshaus "Hirtenfelder". Frisch gestarkt geht es zur Tierbeobachtung in den "Naturwinkel Saufuss". Familie Prinz hat hier mit der Pflege verletzter oder verlassener Tiere begonnen, daraus hat sich zusatzlich ein Artenschutzprojekt entwickelt. Nach einer kurzen Einkehr in einer groSSen Hutte, der Therme Loipersdorf, wird im Uhudlerviertel am Hochberg Station gemacht. die Gegend ist die Heimat des einst geschmahten Uhudlers. In der "Hoch-Zeitschenke" in Eltendorf haben das Wirtsehepaar Matthias und Carina tatsachlich geheiratet und bieten diese Moglichkeit nun auch anderen Paaren an.

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.desc: The hiking season has started, and Harry Prunster sets out again to present new hat and hiking trails in Austria. It starts with the Lavanttal in Karnten. From the Saubalpe, Harry sets off to the monastery hoot on the Brandl. This hates belongs to the St.Paul Abbey, the landmark of the region. Landess Anneliese already runs her in the seventh year, and she can't imagine anything more beautiful than being here in the great outdoors, to spoil the guest and take care of her cows. It is also called "barefoot host" by the locals. Harry is also greeted barefoot by her and she will always have her dream to run her own alpine hut. She likes to serve her guest roast pork, deer goulash and mushroom soup with sterz. The wolfsberger hute is Harry's last stop. The Saulape Hutte Hutte in 1850 meters Seehohe is also an Alpine club hat and is managed by Richard. He is understood by his wife Angie, who is also in the Kuche and prepared Carnison specialists, such as Kasnudeln. / Die Wandersaison hat begonnen, und Harry Prunster macht sich wieder auf um neue Hutten und Wanderwege in Österreich vorzustellen. Den Anfang macht das Lavanttal in Karnten. Von der Saualpe macht sich Harry zur Stiftshutte am Brandl auf. Diese Hutte gehort dem Stift St.Paul, dem Wahrzeichen der Region. Wirtin Anneliese betreibt sie bereits im siebenten Jahr, und sie kann sich nichts Schoneres vorstellen als hier in der freien Natur zu sein, die Gaste zu verwohnen und auf die Kuhe aufzupassen.Die Reisberger Hutte wird von Gertrude "Gerti" Edegger bewirtschaftet. Sie wird von den Einheimischen auch "BarfuSSwirtin" genannt. Harry wird von ihr auch barfuSS empfangen und sie erzahlt, dass es immer ihr Traum war eine eigene Almhutte zu betreiben. Sie serviert ihren Gasten gerne Schweinsbraten, Hirschgulasch und Schwammerlsuppe mit Sterz.Die Wolfsbergerhutte ist Harrys letzte Station. Die hochstgelegen Hutte der Saulape in 1850 Meter Seehohe ist auch eine Alpenvereinshutte und wird von Richard Bester bewirtschaftet. Tatkraftig unterstutzt wird er von seiner Frau Angie, die auch in der Kuche steht und Karntner Spezialitaten, wie Karntner Kasnudeln zubereitet.

programme.title: Harrys liabste Huttn / Harrys liabste Huttn
programme.sub-title: Niedernsill - Piesendorf, Nationalpark Hohe Tauern, Salzburg
programme.desc: In the Salzburg part of the Hohe Tauern National Park, Harry Prunster hikes to the Pinzgauer Hutte from Hermann and Christian Schatzer in 1700 meters Seehohe. Hausmannkost such as Kaspressknodel, Kaiserschmarren and according to the season is also served and also deer roasts and Schwammerlgerichte.christine and Andreas Kammelander are the innkeepers on the Hochsonnbergalm, Andreas Kiefert around the cows, pigs and horses and Christians around the economy. The trained chef Christine is particularly proud of her homemade sausages and kase. In summer, Vroni and Hans Foidl hike to the Schaunbergalm with all animals. Vroni creates butter and kase from the cows, the whey is fed to the pigs. And in the evening, when the work is done, Hans likes to sit in front of the hat and wait for the marmot, which, as he says, "belong to decoration". / In den Salzburger Teil des Nationalparks Hohe Tauern wandert Harry Prunster auf die in 1700 Meter Seehohe gelegene Pinzgauer Hutte von Hermann und Christian Schatzer. Serviert wird vor allem Hausmannskost wie Kaspressknodel, Kaiserschmarren und entsprechend der Saison auch Hirschbraten und Schwammerlgerichte.Christine und Andreas Kammelander sind die Wirtsleute auf der Hochsonnbergalm, Andreas kummert sich um die Kuhe, Schweine und Pferde und Christine um die Wirtschaft. Besonders stolz ist die gelernte Kochin Christine auf ihre selbstgemachten Wurste und Kase. Im Sommer wandern Vroni und Hans Foidl mit allen Tieren auf die Schaunbergalm. Von den Kuhen erzeugt Vroni Butter und Kase, die anfallende Molke wird an die Schweine verfuttert. Und am Abend, wenn die Arbeit erledigt ist, sitzt Hans gerne vor der Hutte und wartet auf die Murmeltiere, die wie er sagt "zur Dekoration gehoren".

programme.title: Peter and Paul / Peter und Paul
programme.desc: The information from Peters Ruckig from his vacation on the North Sea immediately hits waves. Not only does he want to be welcomed with brass music, he will also come with a new lifeacher. When the time comes, it puts the language of everyone. The train arises in a blurred lovers. Nicht nur, dass er mit Blasmusik empfangen werden will, er wird auch mit neuer Lebensgefahrtin kommen. Als es dann soweit ist, verschlagt es allen die Sprache. Dem Zug entsteigt ein unverblumt turtelndes Liebespaar. Nur Paul kennt die "Neue" aus dem Strip-Lokal Bongo-Bar.

programme.title: Peter and Paul / Peter und Paul
programme.desc: The day begins for Paul Schneck with an outrageous discovery. On the meadow in front of the village pond, sun worshipers have spread splinter fibers. Peter Elfinger also experiences a surprise. His secretary and that of his eternal opponent Paul expect a child from his son. But that's not all, the horror of both gentlemen has just started. / Der Tag beginnt fur Paul Schneck mit einer ungeheuerlichen Entdeckung. Auf der Wiese vorm Dorfweiher haben sich Sonnenanbeter splitterfasernackt breit gemacht. Auch Peter Elfinger erlebt eine Überraschung. Seine Sekretarin sowie die seines ewigen Kontrahenten Paul erwarten von seinem Sohn ein Kind. Doch das ist noch lange nicht alles, das Entsetzen beider Herren hat eben erst begonnen.
